findings.claim: The cross-harness lint does not enforce required prompt sections for Codex, OpenCode, Kimi, or MiniMax definitions.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion 'Agent definitions are linted' requires lint to fail when 'a required prompt section, the PHI-lane block or the Harness card is missing'; however `mdAgent` only checks description/name/extra plus `generatedSections(where, body)`, and the Codex checker only checks keys plus `generatedSections(where, t["developer_instructions"] ?? "")`, where `generatedSections` checks only `## Patient-data lane` and `## Harness card`.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a shared required-section check for the prompt body/developer_instructions for every harness, reusing the Claude required-section logic or exporting it from agent-lint.
